== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[Darth Vader]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label. Use Show changes before saving, then check both the new article and existing family members. The current article highlights automatically.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Darth Vader (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity. Era and set headings are linked, bold and underlined; publication entries use normal links. The PC errata of the Decipher card has its own explicitly labeled group, rather than assigning a later PC rewrite to the Decipher publishing era.

This reversible Dark Side pilot covers the eleven existing family articles identified for the second test. The English Reflections foil is a known follow-up publication-inventory gap; it is not represented by an ordinary black-border image or an invented playable ID. Other Vader personas, including [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]] and [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]], belong to their own card families.
</noinclude>
